name: Associated Bank
outlook:
What Associated Bank says to expect

  • 2026: loan growthWe continue to expect 2026 period end loan growth of 18% to 20% as compared to Associated's standalone results for the year ended December 31, 2025.
  • 2026: net interest income growthWe continue to expect 2026 net interest income growth of 19% to 21% as compared to Associated's standalone results for the year ended December 31, 2025.
  • 2026: noninterest expense growthWe now expect 2026 noninterest expense growth of 19% to 20% as compared to Associated's standalone results for the year ended December 31, 2025.
  • 2026: effective tax rateWe now expect the annual effective tax rate to be between 20% and 22% in 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 22, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
